names.name: Boba
names.said: The newest thing on an old board, usually in a different typeface.

text.what: Tea with milk and tapioca pearls, sealed under a film lid and drunk through a fat straw.
text.story: Bubble tea came out of Taiwan in the 1980s and spread through Taiwanese and Chinese diaspora communities. American donut shops with Asian-American owners have added it to the board as a second-generation move: a product with a young customer and a better margin than a glazed.
text.today: A shop that adds boba is usually adding it beside the donuts, not instead of them.

kin.as: The board it turns up on.
The other recent arrival in the same case.

text.story.note: the margin reading is this project's; the Taiwanese origin is cited
